title: Geno's Crystals
description: Adds several crystals and crystal related activities to the game.
body:
The current list of crystals in the game are limited, however already adds:

The Heart Crystal - Increases your maximum HP by by one heart every time you use one. Can also be imbued onto a weapon using an Anvil block.

![The Crafting Recipe of a Heart Crystal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98c03e6b88304bea86fc489b0591fbc5e106583b.png)

The Shadow Crystal - Used to craft an all new weapon that applies an all new effect. You get the Shadow Crystal by defeating either a Warden, or a Wither.

![The Recipe to Craft a Black Knife](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ecf61618c50e631ae68a3ef25d958f9e512e8912.png)

Further it also adds my signature, the Shard Flower, which can be found in the Dark Forest biome.

All textures are subject to change and all features are subject to change also.

A playthrough of this mod takes an average of 5 hours.

I have seen a lot of scraping sites recently re-host my mod(s) without my permission, if you are downloading my mods on any other site, than Curseforge or Modrinth, there is a 100% chance that it is either malicious, or a cash-grab. While I do my best to take these down all by myself, I cannot do it fast enough.
